hero.title: Umuhanga mu Ikoranabuhanga (Full-Stack) & Mpanga udushya
hero.bio: Ndi injeniyeri ya software ufite ishyaka ryo guhanga ibisubizo by'ikoranabuhanga bigezweho kandi bizana impinduka nziza. Mfite ubuhanga muri 'full-stack development' n'ubushobozi bwo gushushanya ibikorwa byiza.

about.title: Ibindi Kuri Njye
about.subtitle: Menya byinshi ku rugendo rwanjye n'ibitera ishyaka ryanjye mu ikoranabuhanga
about.journeyText: Ishyaka ryanjye mu ikoranabuhanga ryatangiriye mu ishuri ryisumbuye rya Gikonko, aho navumbuye imbaraga zo gukoresha code mu gukemura ibibazo by'isi. Kuva icyo gihe, nagiye mu rugendo rwo kwiga no gukura, niga neza ikoranabuhanga n'uburyo butandukanye.
about.loveText: Nkunda guhanga ibisubizo byiza ku bibazo bigoye. Nkunda gukorana n'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, kubaka interineti zoroheye abakoresha, no kunoza imikorere. Iyo ntari muri code, usanga ndi gushakisha ibigezweho mu ikoranabuhanga cyangwa ngira uruhare mu mishinga ya open-source.
about.missionText: Gukoresha ikoranabuhanga mu guhanga ibisubizo bishya bigira impinduka nziza. Nemera kwandika code isobanutse, yoroshye kubungabunga no kubaka ibicuruzwa bidahura gusa n'ibisabwa bya tekiniki ahubwo binatanga uburambe budasanzwe ku bakoresha.

cv.title: Injeniyeri wa Porogaramu | Umuhanga mu Ikoranabuhanga (Full-Stack) | Blockchain & Web3 | Umushushanyi
cv.summary: Ndi Injeniyeri ya Porogaramu (Software Engineer) ufite ishyaka n'uburambe bw'imyaka 3-5 mu gukora porogaramu z'imbuga (full-stack), backend, n'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho. Mfite ubuhanga mu kubaka sisitemu nini kandi zikora neza nkoresheje Node.js, React, Next.js, PHP, MySQL, MongoDB, Flutter, na blockchain. Ndi umunyamurava, witanga, kandi nshyira imbere kwandika code isobanutse, yoroshye kumva, no gutanga ibisubizo by'ikoranabuhanga byizewe. Mfite n'uburambe mu gushushanya (graphic design, UI/UX) no gukorera hamwe n'abandi ku buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga.

experience.description: Yashushanyije kandi yubaka sisitemu za backend yibanda kuri APIs, kwemeza, n'imiterere ya database. Yakoreye kure kandi yatanze code yoroheye abatangizi, ishobora kubungabungwa.
Yakoreye ku ndangamuntu z'ibigo, ibishushanyo bya UI, ibyapa, n'ibikoresho byo kwamamaza.

achievementsList: Yubatse sisitemu nyinshi z'isi nyayo (School MIS, SIMS, PSSMS, Student Portals).
Yashoboye guhuza neza imiyoboro ya backend-frontend mu mishinga myinshi.
Yateje imbere ubumenyi binyuze mu mahugurwa y'umwuga aturuka kuri Cyberu.
Yamenyekanye ku bwitange, imyitwarire, n'ubunyamwuga mu bwubatsi bwa porogaramu.

projectsList.title: Sisitemu y'Irembo ry'Amaresitora
